messages.subject: Cross-validation
parts:
I am using INLA to predict missing days from air monitoring stations. How can I do some sort of automated cross-validation of my model?

Thanks,
Eric

messages.author: bbb9357156c132fe
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Cross-validation
parts:
I'm not sure what you mean here...

INLA will give you CPO values, which are cross-validated predictive densities (see http://www.math.ntnu.no/%7Ehrue/r-inla.org/papers/festschrift.pdf)

There shouldn't be any parameters left to estimate by cross validation. 

D
